title: 第一三五一章 焦急第一三五零章 姜千王和虚暮伦
content_zh:
“这么厉害？”狄九暗自心惊，幸好他还没有跨入第六步，如果已经跨入第六步了，那他现在去找姜千王怕是去丢脸的。他都第六步了，还和放九重差不多的实力，去了岂不是丢脸？
放九重点点头没有说话，因为姜千王的确是这么厉害。狄九的实力他见识过，也许狄九还有后手没有施展出来，不过他一样有后手。狄九和姜千王比起来，还要差许多。
“那虚暮伦又是什么人？”沉默了一会后，狄九再次问道。
放九重同样沉默下来，好一会后他才说道，“此人比姜千王还要神秘，我怀疑他的实力比姜千王还要强。可惜他从始至终都没有出过手，我根本就不知道他的底细。当初如果他出手阻拦，我想要逃走，恐怕要用更大的代价。”
狄九点点头，“你的怀疑是有道理的。”
一般来说，两个强者走在一起，遇见对手了，都是弱的先出手，强的压阵。正因为如此，狄九才说放九重说的有道理。
放九重叹了口气，“我之所以担心，倒不是怕现在的姜千王，而是怕再晋级的姜千王。姜千王很有可能到了万道归流的层次……”
“什么意思？”狄九一时间没有反应过来，看着放九重。
放九重说道，“姜千王最初修炼的大道是生死大道，他在混沌之中感悟了万道归流之后，就有能力将别人的大道化为自己大道分支。正因为如此，他才四处剥离强大修士的道基，然后再将其汇集到自己的大道之中，壮大自己的大道层次，增强自己的实力。”
狄九没有说话，他早就猜到了姜千王应该也是凝练了和他道树一样的大道主干。或者姜千王凝练的不是道树，而是道海，汇集无数河流分支，其实道理也是一样的。
我一直认为姜千王是第七步强者，但和你一战后，我有些怀疑姜千王现在并不是第七步，而是第六步圆满。如果姜千王真的是第六步圆满，那就太过可怕了。
狄九听到这话，心里一跳。
他发现自己也有些先入为主了，他同样以为姜千王是第七步强者。事实上放九重猜错的才是对的，姜千王很有可能还没有到第七步。姜千王正因为没有到第七步，这才四处寻找顶级大道道枝，然后借助这顶级的大道道枝跨入第七步。
若真的是这样，一旦姜千王跨入第七步，他就算是马上晋级到了第六步，对上姜千王，恐怕也是输多胜少。
放九重继续说道，“姜千王和虚暮伦现在在一起，我不知道他们要做什么，以我的经验判断，这两人很有可能在寻找顶级的规则宇宙世界。唯一的目的，应该就是要毁掉这些被他们发现的规则宇宙世界，然后剥离其中的宇宙道则来完善他们的大道。”
“闪电……”狄九听到这里，毫不犹豫的叫了一声。
闪电几乎以最快的速度落在了狄九面前，谄媚的说道，“太爷，有什么吩咐？”
它在这混沌飞星上修炼，简直是一日千里。若是想要突破跨入更高层次，最好是有一条宇宙道脉。就是狄九不叫它，它也打算向狄九要一条宇宙道脉。
狄九没有理睬闪电，而是看着放九重，“放道友，可否将虚暮伦和姜千王的画像勾出来？”
放九重没有半点犹豫，虚空中随手一带，姜千王的大头和虚暮伦飘逸洒脱的形象就出现在虚空之中。

闪电一看就这两个画像，立即就叫道，“太爷，就是这两个家伙，他们在混沌之中闲逛，还说寻找有生命的大道规则宇宙，完善他们的大道之源。”
狄九的脸色变得难看起来，他的手立即就落在了闪电的头上的闪电标识上。闪电看见狄九脸色不好看，没有敢要宇宙道脉，也没有敢动。
良久之后，狄九收回了手，缓声说道，“我肯定闪电被姜千王和虚暮伦做了道则印记，可是我竟然感受不到。这印记很有可能是虚暮伦做的，姜千王的印记我熟悉。”
“太爷……”闪电不解的看着狄九。
狄九沉声说道，“当初在混沌中，你在一边窥视那两个家伙的时候，应该被别人发现了。”
“不可能吧，如果被发现了，我还能在这里？”闪电疑惑的说道。
狄九冷哼道，“你是七爪神鲲不错，但那也只是在部分人眼里有价值，在真正的强者眼里，七爪神鲲也就这样罢了，更何况，他们放走你怕是要寻找你背后的人，也就是我了。”
“啊……”闪电眼里现出惊恐。
狄九拿出一枚戒指递给闪电说道，“这里有宇宙道脉和一些道果，你立即去闭关，争取短时间内跨入第五步。”
“是，太爷。”闪电赶紧抓起戒指，闪了一下，迅速消失在远处。
狄九眼里有些焦急，他看着放九重说道，“放道友，我必须现在就闭关修炼，争取再进一步。我想请你帮忙，控制着混沌飞星前往九重天的所在，我担心姜千王和虚暮伦会对那里下手。”
放九重听到狄九的话微微一笑，“不会，他们虽然要寻找有生命的大道宇宙，倒也不至于对九重天下手。九重天是我留下来的，那个地方的大道规则，无法让姜千王或者虚暮伦大道提升，他们要寻找的是更高的规则……”
狄九抬手止住了放九重的话，语气凝重的说道，“放道友，那个地方早已不再是当初的九重天宇宙了。我和两个兄弟一起，在混沌之中借助混沌构建了全新的规则宇宙世界。这个宇宙世界的规则是不受任何限制的，因为宇宙世界本身就在成长。只要有足够的悟性，就能达到足够的高度。”
“啊……”放九重被狄九的话惊呆了，借助浩瀚混沌构建宇宙世界？他现在也做不到啊。
狄九再次说道，“放道友，我那两个兄弟的大道不会比我的差半分，我们三个的大道互补，虽然还缺一些大道规则，可已能完整的撑起一个宇宙世界了。一旦那个宇宙世界被姜千王和虚暮伦找到，只要剥离了那个世界的根本规则，就足以让他们两个跨入神境九层……”
狄九这话没有半点夸张，他修炼的是规则大道，叶默修炼的是万物大道，而宁城修炼的是归一大道。
这三个大道分支一旦被姜千王得到，姜千王跨入神境九层那仅仅只剩下了时间而已。更不要说还有一个比姜千王还要神秘的虚暮伦？
放九重的脸色也变了，他嘴里喃喃自语，片刻后，他语气肯定的说道，“你猜的恐怕不会有错了，无论是姜千王还是虚暮伦影都是在寻找你们构建的那个全新的宇宙世界。他们怎么知道的我不清楚，但我们必须现在就去阻止他们……”
放九重的话突兀顿住，嘴角露出苦涩。没错，他们必须现在就要去阻止姜千王和放九重，可是他们拿什么去阻止？以他和狄九的实力，恐怕还不是姜千王和虚暮伦的对手。
狄九知道放九重的意思，他一摆手说道，“放道友只需要赶路即刻，我需要在闭关一段时间。我相信再有一段时间，我就可以进一步。若是我们赶到及时，姜千王应该还没有晋级，我相信可以做掉他。”

“好。”放九重没有半点犹豫，直接说了一个好字，然后接过了狄九递给他的一枚控制玉符。
（今天的更新就到这里，朋友们晚安！）
content_en:
"So powerful?" Di Jiu was secretly shocked. Fortunately, he hadn't taken the sixth step yet. If he had already taken the sixth step, he would probably be embarrassed if he went to find King Jiang Qian now. He is already in the sixth step, and his strength is almost the same as that of Fang Jiuzhong. Wouldn't it be embarrassing to go?
Fang Jiudian nodded and said nothing, because King Jiang Qian was indeed so powerful. He has seen Di Jiu's strength before. Maybe Di Jiu still has some backup plans that he hasn't used yet, but he still has backup plans. Compared with King Jiang Qian, Di Jiu was much worse.
"Who is Xu Mulun?" After a moment of silence, Di Jiu asked again.
Fang Jiuzhong also fell silent. After a while, he said, "This person is even more mysterious than King Jiang Qian. I suspect that he is even stronger than King Jiang Qian. Unfortunately, he never made a move from beginning to end. I don't know his details at all. If he had tried to stop me, I would have to pay a higher price for my escape."
Di Jiu nodded, "Your suspicion is justified."
Generally speaking, when two strong men come together and meet their opponents, the weak one will strike first and the strong one will hold the line. Because of this, Di Jiucai said that Fang Jiuzhong made sense.
Fang Jiuzhong sighed, "The reason why I'm worried is not that I'm afraid of the current Jiang Qianwang, but that I'm afraid of the Jiang Qianwang who will be promoted again. Jiang Qianwang is very likely to reach the level of the return of all realms..."
"What do you mean?" Di Jiuyi didn't react for a moment and looked at Fang Jiuzhong.
Fang Jiuchong said, "The avenue that King Jiang Qian first cultivated was the avenue of life and death. After he realized the return of all the ways in the chaos, he was able to turn other people's avenues into branches of his own avenue. Because of this, he stripped off the foundations of powerful monks everywhere, and then gathered them into his own avenue to strengthen his own avenue level and enhance his own strength."
Di Jiu didn't say anything. He had already guessed that King Jiang Qian had also condensed the main trunk of the Dao tree that was the same as his Dao tree. Perhaps what Jiang Qianwang condensed was not the Dao tree, but the Dao sea, which gathered countless river branches. In fact, the truth is the same.
I have always thought that Jiang Qianwang is the seventh step of power, but after the battle with you, I have some doubts that Jiang Qianwang is not the seventh step, but the sixth step. If King Jiang Qian really reached the sixth step of perfection, it would be too terrifying.
When Di Jiu heard this, his heart skipped a beat.
He found that he also had some preconceptions. He also thought that King Jiang Qian was a seventh-step expert. In fact, the correct one was Fang Jiuzhong who guessed wrong, and Jiang Qianwang probably hadn't reached the seventh step yet. It was precisely because King Jiang Qian had not reached the seventh step that he looked around for the top-level Dao Branch, and then used this top-level Dao Branch to step into the seventh step.
If this is really the case, once Jiang Qianwang reaches the seventh step, even if he immediately advances to the sixth step, he will probably lose more than he wins against Jiang Qianwang.
Fang Jiuzhong continued, "King Jiang Qian and Xu Mulun are together now. I don't know what they are going to do. Judging from my experience, these two people are likely to be looking for the top rules universe. The only purpose should be to destroy these rule universes they discovered, and then strip away the laws of the universe to perfect their way."
"Lightning..." Di Jiu shouted without hesitation when he heard this.
Lightning landed in front of Di Jiu at almost the fastest speed, and said flatteringly, "Master, what are your orders?"
It was practicing on this Chaos Flying Star, making rapid progress. If you want to break through and reach a higher level, it is best to have a cosmic path. Even if Di Jiu doesn't call it, it still plans to ask Di Jiu for a cosmic path.
Di Jiu ignored Lightning and looked at Fang Jiuzhong, "Fellow Taoist Fang, can you draw the portraits of Xu Mulun and Jiang Qianwang?"
Without any hesitation, Jiang Qianwang's big head and Xu Mulun's elegant and free-spirited image appeared in the void.
As soon as Lightning saw these two portraits, he immediately shouted:, "Master, these are the two guys, they are wandering in the chaos, and they are also talking about looking for a living universe to rule the universe and perfect the source of their avenue."
Di Jiu's face turned ugly, and his hand immediately fell on the lightning logo on Ling Ling's head. Lightning saw that Di Jiu's face was not good-looking, and he didn't dare to ask for the cosmic path, nor did he dare to move.
After a long time, Di Jiu withdrew his hand and said slowly, "I am sure that the lightning was marked by Dao rules by Jiang Qianwang and Xu Mulun, but I can't feel it. This mark is most likely made by Xu Mulun. I am familiar with Jiang Qianwang's mark."
"Master..." Lightning looked at Di Jiu puzzled.
Di Jiu said in a deep voice, "Back in the chaos, when you were peeking at those two guys, someone else should have discovered you."
"Impossible? If I were discovered, would I still be here?" Lightning said doubtfully.
Di Jiu snorted coldly, "It's good that you are the Seven-clawed Divine Kun, but that is only valuable in the eyes of some people. In the eyes of the truly strong, the Seven-clawed Divine Kun is nothing more than that. What's more, if they let you go, they might be looking for the person behind you, which is me."
"Ah..." Lightning's eyes showed fear.
Di Jiu took out a ring and handed it to Lightning and said, "Here are the universe's Dao veins and some Dao fruits. You should go to retreat immediately and try to reach the fifth step in a short time."
"Yes, Master." Lightning quickly grabbed the ring, flashed it, and quickly disappeared into the distance.
Di Jiu's eyes were a little anxious. He looked at Fang Jiuzhong and said, "Fellow Taoist Fang, I must practice in seclusion now and strive to take a further step. I want to ask for your help to control the Chaos Flying Star to go to Jiuzhongtian. I'm worried that King Jiang Qian and Xu Mulun will attack there."
Fang Jiuzhong smiled slightly when he heard Di Jiu's words, "No, although they want to find a living universe, they will not attack Jiuzhong. I left Jiuzhong. The rules of the Dao in that place cannot improve the Dao of Jiang Qianwang or Xu Mulun. What they are looking for are higher rules..."
Di Jiu raised his hand to stop Fang Jiuzhong's words, and said in a solemn tone, "Fellow Taoist Fang, that place is no longer the original Jiuzhongtian universe. Together with my two brothers, I built a new regular universe in the chaos with the help of chaos. The rules of this universe are not subject to any restrictions, because the universe itself is growing. As long as you have enough understanding, you can reach a sufficient height."
"Ah..." Fang Jiuzhong was stunned by Di Jiu's words, using the vast chaos to build the universe? He can't do it now.
Di Jiu said again, "Fellow Taoist, the avenues of my two brothers will not be half worse than mine. The three of us have complementary avenues. Although there are still some avenue rules, we can fully support a cosmic world. Once that cosmic world is found by Jiang Qianwang and Xu Mulun, as long as the fundamental rules of that world are stripped away, it will be enough for the two of them to step into the ninth level of the divine realm..."
Di Jiu's words were not an exaggeration. He practiced the Rules Avenue, Ye Mo practiced the All Things Avenue, and Ning Cheng practiced the Guiyi Avenue.
Once these three branches of the avenue are obtained by Jiang Qianwang, there will only be time left for Jiang Qianwang to enter the ninth level of the divine realm. Not to mention that there is a Xu Mulun who is even more mysterious than Jiang Qianwang?
Fang Jiuzhong's expression also changed. He murmured to himself. After a moment, he said with a firm tone, "I'm afraid your guess is not wrong. Both Jiang Qianwang and Xu Mulunying are looking for the brand new cosmic world you built. I don't know how they know, but we must stop them now..."
Fang Jiuchong paused suddenly, with bitterness on his lips. Yes, they must stop Jiang Qianwang and Fang Jiuchong now, but what can they do to stop them? With the strength of him and Di Jiu, they may not be the opponents of King Jiang Qian and Xu Mulun.
DiJiu knew what he meant by releasing Jiuzhong. He waved his hand and said, "You only need to go on your way now. I need to stay in seclusion for a while. I believe that after a while, I can go further. If we arrive in time, King Jiang Qian will not be promoted yet. I believe we can kill him."
"Okay." Fang Jiuzhong said the word "good" without any hesitation, and then took the control jade talisman handed to him by Di Jiu.
(That’s it for today’s update, good night, friends!)
